Currency News reported on 31 March 2025 that "The Central Bank of the UAE has issued a new 100 dirham (AED) polymer banknote, printed by Oumolat"; a 2023 Currency News profile says Oumolat Security Printing began operations in 2016, was owned and started by the Emirates Investment Authority and was "then transferred to the Central Bank of UAE".

Norges Bank's own page on its banknote series states that "From 2020, the printing will be carried out by Crane NXT in Malta", after Oberthur Fiduciaire in France printed the notes in 2016-2019; Norges Bank paid about NOK 0.55 per note for the notes issued in 2017.

Dabanga reported in February 2019 that Sudan's new 200-pound banknote went into production at the Sudanese Company for Currency Printing, a domestic press the prime minister visited that week; the report does not state the company's ownership.
source_title: 200, 500 Sudanese Pound banknotes now roll off press (Dabanga Sudan)

detail: The Central Bank of Uzbekistan lists the state production association Davlat Belgisi (an LLC under the Central Bank, comprising the Tashkent Printing Factory, Tashkent Paper Factory and Tashkent Mint) among its subordinate organisations, with its core business given as production of banknote and other security papers, banknotes and passports.
source_title: Subordinate organizations (Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan)

detail: Banco Central de Bolivia award resolution PRES-GAL No 19/2023, issued in La Paz on 27 July 2023, awarded its international banknote tender LPI 001-2023 to Oberthur Fiduciaire SAS for USD 25,945,787.00, covering 321.5 million notes of 10, 20, 50, 100 and 200 bolivianos.
source_title: Resolucion LPI 001-2023 adjudicacion (Banco Central de Bolivia)

detail: La Prensa reported that the Banco Central de Honduras awarded private tender 11/2023 to Crane Currency Malta Limited to print the 200-lempira note, by resolution 127-3/2024 of 14 March 2024, for USD 1,284,000 at 6.42 US cents per note.
source_title: Impresion del billete de 200 lempiras adjudicada a Crane Currency (La Prensa, Honduras)

detail: LexLatin reported on 27 March 2024 that Orell Fussli was partially awarded a tender "para la impresion y suministro de billetes del Banco Central de Nicaragua"; no value or quantity is given.
